name: Identity Prompting (Feature 5)
description: When the identity resolver encounters unknown identifiers, surface them for resolution. After each run, collect unknown_identifiers from resolver, run suggest_match() for candidates, present to user in interactive mode or log in non-interactive mode. Persist confirmed mappings to AliasStore. Add --resolve-identities CLI flag. Default to non-interactive (log-and-skip) to avoid blocking CI. Implemented as a thin orchestrator layer composing identity_collection and identity_cli_integration dependencies with minimal new types.

functions.name: IdentityPromptingOrchestrator.run
functions.description: Async. The primary entrypoint for the identity prompting pipeline. Executes the full orchestration: (1) collect unknowns via UnknownCollector.collect_and_match(), (2) pre-filter identifiers already in AliasStore, (3) sort remaining unknowns deterministically by identifier, (4) for each unknown, call presenter.present() to get a ResolutionDecision, (5) persist confirmed mappings to AliasStore via UnknownCollector.confirm_match(), (6) build and return an OrchestratorResult containing the ResolutionReport and per-unknown PromptingOutcomes. Handles per-unknown errors gracefully by recording them in outcomes without aborting the batch. Supports Ctrl+C interruption with partial progress persistence via persist_partial_progress() from identity_cli_integration.

inputs.name: self
inputs.description: The orchestrator instance.

inputs.name: unknown_identifiers
inputs.description: A list of raw unknown identifier strings to process. May be empty (early return). Duplicates are collapsed via frozenset conversion internally.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The origin context for the unknown identifiers (e.g., 'git_log', 'post_run_scan').

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: The identity resolution configuration controlling thresholds, output path, and interactive mode.

error_cases.name: config_invalid

preconditions: The orchestrator has been properly initialized via __init__ with all dependencies
config is a valid IdentityResolutionConfig instance
source is a non-empty string
config.output_path parent directory exists and is writable (if non-interactive mode)
postconditions: If unknown_identifiers is empty, returns an OrchestratorResult with empty report (zero totals, no decisions, not interrupted) and empty outcomes
result.total_input_count equals len(set(unknown_identifiers)) (deduplicated count)
result.pre_filtered_count equals the number of identifiers already in AliasStore
result.outcomes contains one PromptingOutcome per deduplicated input identifier
Every PromptingOutcome with status RESOLVED has its confirmed mapping persisted to AliasStore
result.report.total_processed equals total_input_count minus pre_filtered_count
Unknowns are processed in sorted order by identifier string for reproducibility
Per-unknown errors are recorded as ERRORED outcomes and do not abort the batch
result.started_at <= result.completed_at
If the run was interrupted, result.report.interrupted is true and partial progress was persisted (best-effort)
result.presenter_mode_used reflects the actual mode used (may differ from config.interactive if TTY was unavailable)
side_effects: Reads from AliasStore to pre-filter known aliases
Invokes MatchSuggester.suggest_match() concurrently for each unknown identifier
Calls presenter.present() for each unknown (may write to stdout/stderr or log)
Persists confirmed alias mappings to AliasStore via UnknownCollector.confirm_match()
In non-interactive mode: may write YAML file at config.output_path via serialize_report_to_yaml()
On interruption: calls persist_partial_progress() to save partial state (best-effort)

inputs.description: The requested prompting mode: INTERACTIVE or NON_INTERACTIVE.

inputs.name: is_tty
inputs.description: Whether stdout is a TTY. If false and mode is INTERACTIVE, the factory silently downgrades to LoggingPresenter.

preconditions: mode is a valid PromptMode enum value

functions.name: convert_match_result_to_suggestions
functions.description: Convert a MatchResult (from identity_collection) to a MatchSuggestionList (from identity_cli_integration) for presentation. Maps MatchCandidate fields to MatchSuggestion fields, preserving ordering by descending confidence. This bridges the type gap between the two dependency contracts.

inputs.name: match_result
inputs.description: A MatchResult from identity_collection containing the unknown identifier and its match candidates.

preconditions: match_result is a valid MatchResult instance from identity_collection
match_result.candidates is sorted by descending confidence
postconditions: Returned MatchSuggestionList has same length as match_result.candidates
Each MatchSuggestion.candidate_person_id equals the corresponding MatchCandidate.canonical_id
Each MatchSuggestion.confidence equals the corresponding MatchCandidate.confidence
Each MatchSuggestion.evidence contains the match_method as a single evidence string
Ordering is preserved (descending confidence)

invariants: IdentityPromptingOrchestrator uses constructor injection for all dependencies — never inheritance
The orchestrator pipeline is always: collect unknowns → filter already-aliased → suggest matches → present (interactive or log) → persist confirmed → build report
Non-interactive mode (PromptMode.LOG) is the default and never blocks on stdin or raises for individual unknown failures
Interactive mode requires a TTY on stdout; if no TTY is detected, the orchestrator silently downgrades to non-interactive mode
Per-unknown errors are caught and recorded in the ResolutionReport — they do not abort the entire batch
Unknowns are processed in deterministic sorted order (sorted by identifier string) for reproducibility
Zero unknowns results in an early return with an empty ResolutionReport (no errors, no side effects)
Pre-filtering via AliasStore.has_alias() is always performed before suggest_match() to avoid redundant work
IdentityPresenter implementations are stateless — all state is passed via method parameters
InteractivePresenter delegates to identity_cli_integration.prompt() for actual TTY I/O
LoggingPresenter always returns a ResolutionDecision with action=SKIP and resolved_person_id=null
Confirmed mappings are persisted to AliasStore before being included in the ResolutionReport
Partial progress is persisted on Ctrl+C via persist_partial_progress() from identity_cli_integration — best-effort, failures are logged not raised
The --resolve-identities CLI flag defaults to false (non-interactive log-and-skip)
YAML serialization of reports is deterministic: same input produces byte-identical output
requires: identity_collection provides UnknownCollector, MatchSuggester, AliasStore, and all value types for collection and matching

identity_cli_integration provides prompt(), resolve_identity_unknowns(), build_config_from_cli(), serialize/deserialize YAML, persist_partial_progress(), CLI flag registration, and all resolution/report types
argparse ArgumentParser instance available at CLI setup time
Pydantic v2 for frozen model construction
